prompt: Overhead on a kitchen table at night lit by one camping lantern: two hands counting a small pile of pound coins and pennies into stacks, beside them a single tin of beans and a stack of opened envelopes, the electricity off. Winter night in a near-future Britain, the streetlights dead, lit only by braziers, camping lanterns and the glow of the city's towers; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
